svg.text: Figure 1 · Every render, and whether a page shows it
40 review renders (8 layouts and postures × 5 views, from render.cjs) and 10 Blender stills (5 shots × 2 liveries, from blender_render.py), plus the line-up and 4 walk clips. 9 renders

Shown by a page (count of pages)
Pages: the concept layouts review, the Blender and concept-art pages, the front-page banner and the wiki (counted once). Pixel size from the file header.

Generated by tools/figures/renders_readme.py from the renders in cad/renders and the code that writes and shows them. Renders of placeholder concept geometry, for review and communication: not a design.

g.text: Terms: CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · KB = kilobyte, a file size of 1,024 bytes
